verdict.rationale: The IRS does run machine channels: MeF, an XML system-to-system rail, and IRIS Application to Application (A2A). So asking about a sandbox is a fair question. But nothing in the evidence documents a public sandbox or test environment for either channel. The pack only shows that both rails are credential-gated: MeF needs e-file provider enrollment, which takes up to 45 days and may require fingerprinting, and IRIS A2A needs a Transmitter Control Code. Probes found no OpenAPI or developer docs at all.
